proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E _ _ _ K x hK
  haveI : CompleteSpace K := hK.isComplete.completeSpace_coe
  refine ⟨(K.starProjection x, x - K.starProjection x),
    ⟨K.starProjection_apply_mem x, K.sub_starProjection_mem_orthogonal x, add_sub_cancel _ _⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨y, z⟩ ⟨hy, hz, hyz⟩
  dsimp only at hy hz hyz
  have hz' : z = x - y := eq_sub_of_add_eq' hyz
  have h1 : K.starProjection x = y :=
    K.eq_starProjection_of_mem_orthogonal hy (by rw [← hz']; exact hz)
  rw [hz', h1]
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E] (K : Submodule 𝕜 E) (x : E), IsClosed (K : Set E) → ∃! p : E × E, p.1 ∈ K ∧ p.2 ∈ K.orthogonal ∧ p.1 + p.2 = x
